text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while training with the support 
of the Three Goddesses—

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Looks like the time has come to 
"acquire" the knowledge you've built up.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Knowledge is history, and history is 
something that connects and intertwines 
with other histories.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Knowledge gathered as isolated points 
connects into lines, and by intersecting, 
gives birth to new understanding.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
You must already be able to see it. What 
lies beyond when knowledge connects with 
knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Now is the time to make that culmination 
and knowledge your own, and pass it on to 
your precious Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, the knowledge accumulated within 
oneself links together to form a greater 
understanding.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Internalizing all this expanded knowledge 
within myself— perhaps right now is the 
time to do it...!
